fixture_author: agent-authored controlled acceptance case; not held out

shared/text.py: Pure whitespace normalization through one stable interface

healthy_and_hub_control.judgment: These roles are authored fixture ground truth; no automated quality/decomposition verdict is claimed.

limitations: Controlled evidence navigation, not a benchmark of model decision quality, novelty or production robustness.
Semantic facts were manually supplied; mapping model quality, latency and cost were not measured.
Function callers are static observations; dynamic dispatch and inferred runtime paths may be missing.
Unrelated scope candidates are evidence to inspect, not proof the tool ordered unnecessary edits.
Healthy utility and overloaded hub deliberately have equal degree; architectural benefit or decomposition advice requires judgment not measured here.
Timings are one local run under concurrent CI/test activity; no statistical speedup claim.
method: Same source fingerprints; separate subprocess/index; actual Python MCP tool projections without HTTP transport; matched manually authored semantic facts.
